# Mad Devs

> > Mad Devs is a software development company providing technical expertise in Go, blockchain, AI systems, and full-cycle product development with emphasis on engineering best practices and developer growth.

The site features technical guides, glossaries, and insights from engineers like Pavel Zverev, Tony Fedorenko, and Oleg Puzanov. Content spans software architecture, blockchain technologies including Bitcoin and smart contracts, AI systems, and practical development workflows using tools like Go, Gorm, and GitHub.

## Key Topics

- Software Development & Architecture
- Blockchain & Smart Contracts
- Agentic AI & Generative AI
- Go Programming & Gorm ORM
- Developer Skills & Career Growth
- Product Management & Discovery
- API Design & Access
- Technical Audits
- Incident Management & Reliability
- No-Code/Low-Code Platforms
- Bitcoin & BRC-20 Tokens
- Database Interface Refactoring
- SOLID Principles
- ChatGPT & AI Agents

## Developer Guides & Best Practices

- [Everything You Need to Know Before Hiring Software Developer](https://maddevs.io/blog/how-to-hire-a-developer): Developer hiring guide with technical assessment and recruitment strategies
- [Ready-to-Use Technical Competency Matrix for Developers](https://maddevs.io/blog/technical-skill-matrix-for-developers): Technical competency matrix for hiring and evaluating developers with Git
- [How to Become a Software Developer](https://maddevs.io/blog/how-to-become-a-software-developer): First-year developer guide covering programming career and communication
- [Important Steps for Software Engineers Growth](https://maddevs.io/blog/the-difference-in-work-for-beginner-and-professional-developers): Career growth guide for software developers from beginner to professional
- [How Important Are Communication Skills in Software Development?](https://maddevs.io/blog/communication-in-software-development): Developer communication skills guide for distributed teams and standups
- [How to Do Effective Refactoring of Heavy Database Interface in Go](https://maddevs.io/blog/effective-refactoring-of-heavy-database-interface): Step-by-step Go refactoring guide for database interfaces using Gorm

## Product Development & Management

- [What Is Product Discovery and How Do You Run It?](https://maddevs.io/blog/product-discovery-process): Agile product discovery process guide for user research and validation
- [Complete Tech Audit Guide: Types, Benefits & Process 2026](https://maddevs.io/customer-university/internal-and-external-software-audits): Comprehensive tech audit guide covering internal vs external approaches
- [Incident Management Metrics That Matter](https://maddevs.io/blog/incident-management-metrics-guide): MTBF, MTTR, MTTA metrics guide for incident management and reliability
- [Dogfooding: What Is It and Why Should You Test Your Own Products](https://maddevs.io/blog/dogfooding): Dogfooding practice guide with Microsoft and Pegasystems examples

## Blockchain & Smart Contracts

- [The Strategic Value of Blockchain Across Industries](https://maddevs.io/blog/blockchain-beyond-cryptocurrency-applications): Blockchain applications beyond Bitcoin in healthcare and supply chains
- [The Cost of Failure in Smart-Contract Development](https://maddevs.io/blog/cost-of-failure-in-smart-contract-development): Ethereum smart contract security vulnerabilities and audit cost guide
- [What Is the Role of BRC-20 in Shaping the Future of Digital Assets](https://maddevs.io/blog/role-of-brc-20-in-shaping-the-future-of-digital-assets): BRC-20 token standard guide for Bitcoin blockchain and Ordinal Theory

## AI & Emerging Technologies

- [What Is Agentic AI? | Glossary of AI Terms](https://maddevs.io/glossary/agentic-ai): AI glossary defining agentic AI, autonomous systems, and generative AI
- [No-Code & Low-Code Development Best Practices and Top Platforms](https://maddevs.io/blog/nocode-lowcode-development): No-code/low-code platforms guide featuring QuickBase and Jotform Apps
- [Top Biotech Startups That Investors Will Pay Attention to in 2026](https://maddevs.io/blog/top-biotech-startups-investors-should-follow): Biotech startup investment guide featuring Amgen and industry analysis

## API & Technical Reference

- [What Is API Access? | API Glossary](https://maddevs.io/glossary/api-access): API glossary defining access, authentication, OAuth, and HTTP methods
- [Easy Guide: Deploing a Svelte App to the Heroku Hosting Platform](https://maddevs.io/blog/how-to-deploy-a-project-on-heroku): Svelte app deployment tutorial for Heroku with Express.js configuration

## Optional

- [Digest #10: Top Articles for February 2023](https://maddevs.io/digest/february-2023): Monthly digest covering remote staffing, Zero Trust, and RPA topics
